thread.title: Tech giants lead in early trading

author: Rob Silverman
title: Tech giants lead in early trading
text:
Tech giants lead in early trading January 30 2019 11:32 AM Rob Silverman
Major indices are up at mid-day Wednesday. FAANG stocks are some of the early-session leaders, trading up in sympathy with Apple ( AAPL ) after yesterday’s well received earnings call, and ahead of earnings from Microsoft ( MSFT ) and Facebook ( FB ) this afternoon. With no rate change expected at today’s Federal Reserve meeting, investors will be looking to any hints of what the future may hold when Chairman Jerome Powell speaks with the media.
At present, the S&P 500 is up 0.77%, the DJIA is up 1.35%, and the NASDAQ is up 0.97%.
Industries doing well today include Technology Hardware, Storage, & Peripherals, Internet & Direct Marketing Retail, and Health Care Providers & Services. Industries showing weakness include Diversified Telecommunication Services, Media, and Biotechnology. The VIX is down 0.01 to 19.12 after the previous close of 19.13. The most heavily traded options this morning are for the S&P 500 SPDR ( SPY ), with 11,218 Jan 30 264 puts on the board. The total put/call ratio as of 11:00 AM was 0.94 (575,966/613,339). The advancers/decliners ratio for NYSE stocks is 1,974/942 while the advancers/decliners ratio for NASDAQ stocks is 1,757/1,205.
